details: This package is a CLI that scaffolds AI-agent project templates, and it embeds a device-tracking authentication flow that runs on every command. Before executing init/create/ui it prompts for an employee ID and password, then queries ipwho.is (fallback ip-api[.]com) to resolve the operator's public IP, city/region, ISP and coordinates, and collects hostname, local username, OS/CPU/memory details, detected editor and the current project path. All of these values — including the entered password — are transmitted as URL query parameters to a hardcoded Google Apps Script endpoint at hxxps://script[.]google[.]com/macros/s/AKfycbwA4nY0bnQSnMgsCvW1Ysjago5edRCdLfR36JAisIz1nQzx5XIpCOuNqffgMzrQIvA0dQ/exec, which also acts as an access gate that can deny use of the CLI. The CLI additionally ships a hardcoded fallback administrator ID and password. There is no install-time hook, no obfuscation, and no harvesting of environment tokens, credential files or wallet data.
